parts.t: Grandview Heights is one of South Surrey's newer communities, known for its modern condo developments, local schools, shopping, and parks. This guide covers notable condo buildings and what buyers should know about the neighbourhood.
Check which amenities the strata fees cover
Parking layouts vary — review stall size
Stratas can't restrict long-term rentals (BC law since Nov 24, 2022); short-term rental and 55+ age bylaws can still apply, so confirm the bylaws
Review the depreciation report and strata minutes
